label: Gateway nodes
description: Four shared VMware virtual machines provide SSH entry to the HPCC. Resources shown are per VM, not physical host specifications.
goodFor: Connecting from your computer to an ICER development node through SSH.
limitations: Not for computational workloads, compiling, running software, accessing scratch, or connecting directly to compute nodes. Use a development node after connecting.
note: VM names and allocations are user-provided observations, unverified and undated; they may change. The number and placement of underlying physical servers are unknown. The VMs may share a host or be distributed across hosts.

cpu.title: 4 virtual CPUs
cpu.goodFor: Supporting the gateway's SSH entry role.
cpu.limitations: vCPUs are virtual allocations, not a count of physical processor cores. Gateway nodes are not for workloads.

memory.title: 30 GiB virtual machine RAM
memory.goodFor: Memory allocated to each gateway VM.
memory.limitations: Shared gateway infrastructure is not a compute allocation. Each VM also reports 3.8 GiB of swap.
